backend.name: Alex Chen
backend.summary: Backend engineer with six years building payment and e-commerce platforms on the JVM.

experience.description: Owned the card payment service handling 3M transactions per day. Introduced idempotency keys so retried client requests never charged a customer twice. Built an event pipeline on Kafka processing 50k messages per second for settlement and fraud signals. Cut p95 checkout latency by 40% through connection pooling and async I/O.

Split the legacy monolith into twelve Spring Boot services behind an API gateway. Added a Redis read-through cache for product pages, reducing database load by 60%. Tuned PostgreSQL queries with composite indexes and EXPLAIN ANALYZE, bringing the slowest report from 9 seconds to 300 ms.

ml.name: Priya Nair
ml.summary: Machine learning engineer focused on recommendation systems and applied NLP.

Developed an XGBoost model that flags members likely to cancel their plan, now used by the retention team. Created a shared feature store and executive dashboards.

frontend.name: Maya Lopez
frontend.summary: Frontend engineer who cares about accessible, fast interfaces.

Shipped responsive marketing sites for retail clients, improving organic search rankings through structured data, meta tags and sitemaps. Built landing page variants for conversion experiments.
